items.markdown:
Invoice financing is `a cash flow solution where businesses use unpaid, outstanding invoices as collateral to borrow money` . Instead of waiting 30 to 90 days for clients to pay, a lender advances up to 95% of the invoice value upfront within 24 hours.[](https://www.smeinvoicefinance.co.uk/) [[1]](https://www.smeinvoicefinance.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.allianz-trade.com/en_GB/insights/protect-revenues/what-is-invoice-financing-and-how-does-it-work.html)[[3]](https://stripe.com/resources/more/invoice-financing-for-small-businesses)

How It Works

1. **Invoice:** You issue an invoice to a business client.
2. **Advance:** You submit the invoice to a financing provider who advances 70% to 95% of the value.
3. **Repayment:** Once your client pays the full invoice amount, you repay the lender the advance plus a fee or interest, and keep the remaining balance.[](https://www.smeinvoicefinance.co.uk/) [[1]](https://www.smeinvoicefinance.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.allianz-trade.com/en_GB/insights/protect-revenues/what-is-invoice-financing-and-how-does-it-work.html)[[3]](https://stripe.com/resources/more/invoice-financing-for-small-businesses)

Main Types

- **Invoice Factoring:** The lender purchases your invoices and takes over the responsibility of collecting payments from your customers.
- **Invoice Discounting:** You receive the advance but retain control of your own sales ledger and collect the payments yourself, keeping the arrangement confidential from your customers.[](https://www.lloydsbank.com/business/invoice-finance.html) [[1]](https://www.lloydsbank.com/business/invoice-finance.html)[[2]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/i/invoice-financing.asp)

Pros and Cons

- **Pros:** Immediate access to working capital, no requirement for physical collateral, and your borrowing power grows alongside your sales.
- **Cons:** Can be expensive due to processing fees and interest rates, and you are still responsible for the debt if the client defaults (unless you purchase "bad debt protection").[](https://www.smeinvoicefinance.co.uk/) [[1]](https://www.smeinvoicefinance.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/i/invoice-financing.asp)[[3]](https://www.allianz-trade.com/en_SG/insights/risk-management/what-is-invoice-financing-and-how-does-it-work.html)[[4]](https://stripe.com/resources/more/invoice-financing-for-small-businesses)[[5]](https://www.iwoca.co.uk/finance-explained/invoice-financing)[[6]](https://www.allianz-trade.com/en_GB/insights/grow-your-business/invoice-finance-a-buyer-s-guide.html)

Learn more about rates and facility options through guides by the [British Business Bank](https://www.british-business-bank.co.uk/business-guidance/guidance-articles/finance/invoice-finance) or [Stripe](https://stripe.com/resources/more/invoice-financing-for-small-businesses).[[1]](https://stripe.com/guides/introduction-to-online-invoicing)
